important_omissions_examined: Nagumo public name/presidency and delayed rules
First names and Yukimura preferred Keisei
School-card image dates and ordinal grades
Ryuen's unchanged Class A goal versus local tactical false answers
Unproven official paper shuffle final results
Ryuen does not know X despite hearing from X
Ichinose clearance with unsigned sender provenance
Hiyori sugar intelligence via prior inquiry

findings.description: Question submitted and school-approved differs from handoff apparently replacing envelope
Final combined 692 threshold authoritative; initial approximately 700 only preliminary
Actual final full class and student outcomes absent; 98 and below 80 are self-estimates
Uniform cheat-sheet and juice incident have inferential causal chain; precise person inserting note not proven
Anonymous X transaction and threat with photo do not identify X in Ryūen's epistemic position
Ichinose fraud refuted; printed Ryūen signature not verified sender
Hiyori's sugar inference is compatible with prior social inquiry; no validated extraordinary sensory capability
Public Nagumo council proposal is not evidence all changes were enacted
Kushida's trust/social manipulation is a first-person historical account; no automatic diagnostic label
Student illustrated card letters must not become arbitrary numerical mental or physical ability scores

Nagumo Miyabi publicly assumes student council presidency; prior pack incorrectly treated given name and presidency as unknown. Announcement of reforms still not confirmation of immediate implementation.
Preserve Haruka Hasebe, Akito Miyake, Teruhiko Yukimura and Keisei preferred social name without renaming actor IDs.
Illustrated school cards give Yukimura July 11 and Satō February 28 birth dates and dated qualitative teacher context; do not convert letter grades to simulation scores.
Ryūen chooses false answers to Kushida but narrator explicitly states his long-term goal of reaching Class A remained unchanged. Separate local tactical decision from goal replacement.
